THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The notebook page

As you record, the four notes fill in. Read them in order, then decide: helpful, harmful, or neither.

THE SCENE

You keep the notebook for a potato study high in the Andes. You are alone in the tent, and one page is still empty. That page is about one change in a potato gene. You need four notes to finish it. Four people each can give you one.

THE HISTORY

People have grown potatoes for thousands of years in the Andes. The farmers near Cusco are Quechua. They keep over a thousand kinds and save the best plants. Their potato park sits high where the sun is strong.
